# Danilo Stoletović

> Full-Stack Developer • Multiplatform & Systems Builder delivering production software across Web, Android, Windows, and Edge environments.

## Summary
Danilo Stoletović is a Full-Stack Developer and Multiplatform & Systems Builder with 3+ years of commercial experience engineering software from initial architecture to global store distribution. Specializing in native Android (Kotlin / Jetpack Compose), cross-platform mobile (Flutter / Dart), Windows desktop applications, zero-bloat web platforms, and edge IoT systems.

## Professional Focus & Domains
- **Mobile & Multiplatform**: End-to-end mobile development with Android Native (Kotlin, Jetpack Compose) and Flutter/Dart, including Google Play Store publishing, app signing, and release management.
- **Desktop & Systems**: Windows desktop engineering (WinUI, C#, Flutter), Microsoft Store publishing, system daemons (Linux/systemd), and hardware integrations (Raspberry Pi 5).
- **Web & Backend**: Zero-JS static architectures, modern JavaScript (ES6+), React, Node.js, Python, Programmatic SEO, and resilient REST/API services.
- **Edge Infrastructure**: Serverless edge deployments via Cloudflare Pages and Workers, Vercel Edge networks, Docker containerization, and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines.

## Technology Stack
- **Mobile**: Kotlin, Jetpack Compose, Flutter, Dart, Google Play Console
- **Desktop & Systems**: WinUI, C#, Flutter Desktop, Microsoft Store, Linux, systemd, Raspberry Pi 5
- **Web**: Semantic HTML5, Modern CSS3, JavaScript (ES6+), React, Node.js, Python
- **Cloud & Edge**: Cloudflare (Pages, Workers, DNS), Vercel, Docker, GitHub Actions CI/CD

## Site Architecture & Performance
- **Zero Client-Side JavaScript**: 0 KB JS runtime, zero hydration overhead, zero layout shifts.
- **100/100 Core Web Vitals**: Instant TTFB, sub-50ms paint times on global edge CDNs.
- **Pure CSS Theming**: Dark obsidian and light theme switching via pure CSS custom properties.
- **Structured Data**: Schema.org JSON-LD microdata (`Person`, `ProfilePage`).
